newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch second quarter gas output rises 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch second quarter gas output rises 14 pct.

text.p: Dutch gas production in the second quarter rose by 14 percent year-on-year due to healthier economic conditions for mining activities, the Ministry for Economic Affairs said on Thursday.
Gas production totalled 16.3 billion cubic metres (bcm), two bcm more than in second quarter 1995. Of the increase, 1.4 bcm came from onshore production.
The resulting half-year figures show a 9.4 bcm rise in gas output to 51.5 bcm.

Oil output was down 15.5 percent, or 130,000 cubic metres (818,000 barrels), in the second quarter to 690,000 cubic metres (4.34 million barrels). In the first half year, oil production was down 300,000 cubic metres (1.89 million barrels) to 1.4 million cubic metres (8.8 million barrels).
